title: Follow a session while it works

captures.name: drawer
captures.title: Open a session
captures.body: Selecting a session opens its conversation beside the list, so the rest of the fleet stays in view.

captures.name: timeline
captures.title: Read the whole transcript
captures.body: Every prompt, reply, tool call and tool result is kept, so you can see exactly what the agent did.

captures.name: tools
captures.title: Filter the noise
captures.body: Hiding the assistant messages leaves the tool calls — the fastest way to audit what an agent touched.

captures.name: reply
captures.title: Steer it mid-run
captures.body: A reply goes to the running agent, so you can redirect the work without restarting it.
